correctness.rationale: Strict trace-inverse convexity on the zero-sum subspace plus injective edge weights proves unrestricted uniqueness; an exact 0,(2a+kb),(nb),(2b+kc)^(k-1) spectrum reduces the KKT system to ratios. Analytically verified interior sign h>k iff r<n/k, c>0, and boundary complementary slackness iff r>=n/k; budget and Euler homogeneity give the optimum. Full-matrix and exact test package verifies 908 cases but is not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This solves a natural continuous resource-allocation question with a distinguished costly link on every complete graph, including every optimal conductance, the exact objective and a sharp deletion boundary. The independent pre-existing D/E thresholds create an exact A/D disagreement width 1/(n-2) and an A/E disagreement width 1 across all n, a nonroutine objective-sensitive structural comparison useful for choosing network design metrics.
